_comment: AI drivers (card 05). cornerMargin = fraction of the computed safe corner speed it uses; brakeMargin = fraction of its estimated max braking it plans with (lower = brakes earlier); lookahead = baseM + perMps x speed; steerKp = gain on the pure-pursuit wheel angle (1 = geometric), steerKd = damping on heading-error change; noise = random steer jitter; mistakesPerMin = chance of a late brake or a wide line; traffic = forward cone and overtaking offset. pits: stop when fuel < fuelLaps laps or any tyre < minWear; drive the pit lane pitSpeedMarginKph under the limit. start: reaction to lights out, random in min..max per driver. aids: traction control on the rears' slip as a fraction of peak (03b). Tune by racing them (panel: T).
